## 修复与读取预览改进

- 修复输入提示词时聊天窗口闪烁的问题（#199）。
- 统一读取、压缩及知识工具与 Edit/Write 的卡片格式，让预览内容包含在卡片内（#197、#198）。
- 读取独立于命令分组显示，移除成功勾选、正文说明栏与多余内层边框，原文切换保留在放大窗口。
- Engineering 增加只读 Investigation 路由与调查预算（#196）。

## Fixes and read previews

- Fix chat flicker while typing a prompt (#199).
- Align read, compression and knowledge tool cards with Edit/Write and contain previews within their cards (#197, #198).
- Show reads outside command groups and simplify preview borders and labels. Source switching remains available in the expanded viewer.
- Add a read-only Engineering Investigation route with a bounded investigation budget (#196).
